integrity: The previously established optimal sizes 6 and 12 are distinguished from the complete equality-layer classification. Exhaustive compatible-clique and ordinary-parent enumerations check 512 constrained maxima, 128 ordinary maxima, 16 invariant parents, 8 viable parents, 64 transversals per viable parent, and four size-128 symmetry orbits.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns labeled length-4 DNA words with exactly two G/C symbols, ordinary Hamming distance at least 3, and reverse-complement Hamming distance at least 3 (including self-pairs). No longer lengths, other GC contents, or alternative hybridization constraints are classified.
title: Complete equality census for the smallest optimal constant-GC reverse-complement DNA code
